in_sanskrit.name: Anurājan
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anu- (one) + Rājan (king, ruler) = Delight, Joy, Pleasure to the one who rules

in_hindi.name: अनुराजन
in_hindi.meaning: अनु- (अनु- वा एक, one) + राजन् (राजा, king) = अनु-राज, the one who rules over one

in_tamil.name: அனுராஜன்
in_tamil.meaning: அனு- (அனு- வா ஐய், one) + ராஜன் (ஜமிிர், king) = அனு-ராஜ, the one who rules over one

in_telugu.name: అనురాజన్
in_telugu.meaning: అను- (అను- ఆడు, one) + రాజన్ (జీదరి, king) = అను-రాజ, the one who rules over one

in_marathi.name: Anuranjan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anuranjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anu means small, tiny or new and Ranjana means delightful or pleasing. The name Anuranjan means a small, new or tiny thing that is delightful or pleasing.

in_bengali.name: Anuranjan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Delightful, Pleasing
in_bengali.long_meaning: Anuranjan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Anu means small, tiny or new and Ranjana means delightful or pleasing. The name Anuranjan means a small, new or tiny thing that is delightful or pleasing.
